notes.title: Update: 0.94
notes.content:
List of changes:
1.Fixed a bug when creating a new game
2.Fixed a bug when a character can't build buildings
3.Fixed graphical artifacts of shaders
4.Fixed the way to save and open the world
5. Fixed the system of random phrases in the hero
6. Fixed slo-mo triggering at low FPS
7. Changed quest system.
8. Changed texture of exploding mushroom
9. Changed the system of enemy spawning
10. Added screen adaptation
11. Improved collision of objects
12. Added music in the menu.
13. Fixed the translation of “English”, “Spanish”
14. Added a slider to adjust the volume of music and sounds
15. Finalized the main game menu
16. Optimization of the game
17. Changed publisher's splash screen

notes.title: Update: 0.91
notes.content:
List of changes:
- Fixed crashing due to large amounts of buildings
- Fixed small minor bugs
- The game is now translated into 7 languages: Russian, English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese.
- New game mechanics: Mutator (Depending on the H-Index scale, difficulty level and player's stats, more difficult zombie species will appear in the game).
- Small mechanics in the game: Exploding mushrooms (Explode at the player's sight and deal damage).
- Fixed the difficulty level in the game.
- New game mechanics: Player can search corpses/trash around the world and get experience points 
- New game mechanic: Skill Tree (Experience points can be used to unlock more advanced buildings).
- Optimized game code, now the game runs smoother.
- Improved physics of torn off body parts
- Added customization section
